name: A320 cabin/system bracket, strength-limited (per kg of the conventional 7075-T6 machined part)

reference_mass.source: normalisation: results are per kg of the conventional machined 7075-T6 part; replace with the task's part mass

fuel_per_kg_per_flight.source: Steinegger 2017 (ZHAW), Fig. 15, A320-200 marginal fuel at 2000/4000/5000 km; full text read by a sub-agent 2026-11-01; not peer-reviewed

flights.source: A320 original approved validity 48,000 FC; ESA I 60,000 FC (Emerald AEAT 2008, doi 10.1108/aeat.2008.12780caf.005, fetch summary 2026-11-01); low 30,000 = assumption (early retirement)

co2_per_kg_fuel.source: ICAO CEC methodology v8 / UK CORSIA Order 2021 art. 28(5); read 2026-10-25 (aerokit.design.sustainability)

grid_co2_per_MJ.source: OWID/Ember carbon intensity of electricity, CSV read 2026-11-01: EU-27 2024 211.2, France 2024 40.5, China 2024 555.4 g/kWh, divided by 3600

co2_per_kg.source: Ashby 2013 family value 12 (Useful Numbers PDF p. 1, read 2026-11-01); range 4.5-22 = IAI 'most footprints' (fetch by sub-agent 2026-11-01)

price_per_kg.source: aerospace Al plate: low 7.5 = Constellium A&T FY2024 revenue/volume (fetch); value and high = assumed distributor premium; research_notes/Hafifletme derin araştırma 2/cost_data.md (sub-agent 2026-11-01; EUR at ECB 16 Sep 2026)

co2_per_kg.source: Ashby 2013 Ti alloys 46.5 (Useful Numbers PDF p. 4, read 2026-11-01); low 16.1 = Ti-6Al-4V ingot on hydro grid, Lessard et al. 2025 SI Table S-2 (sub-agent full PDF)

price_per_kg.source: Ti-6Al-4V sheet 15-50 USD/lb, Dutta & Froes 2014 slide 3; research_notes/Hafifletme derin araştırma 2/cost_data.md (sub-agent 2026-11-01; EUR at ECB 16 Sep 2026)

route_cost_per_kg.source: CNC Ti route per kg finished, template; research_notes/Hafifletme derin araştırma 2/cost_data.md (sub-agent 2026-11-01; EUR at ECB 16 Sep 2026)

price_per_kg.source: Ti-6Al-4V EBM powder 45-106 um, Fraunhofer IAPT 2021 Fig. 13; research_notes/Hafifletme derin araştırma 2/cost_data.md (sub-agent 2026-11-01; EUR at ECB 16 Sep 2026)

route_cost_per_kg.source: EBM/L-PBF Ti route excluding powder; research_notes/Hafifletme derin araştırma 2/cost_data.md (sub-agent 2026-11-01; EUR at ECB 16 Sep 2026)

AlSi10Mg.properties_source: EOS AlSi10Mg M290 datasheet 12.2017, stress-relieved 270 C/90 min: Rp0.2 220 (XY) / 225 (Z) MPa, 2670 kg/m3 (sub-agent full PDF 2026-11-01); E = 72 +- 3 GPa XY as-built (AddUp AlSi10Mg datasheet 2023, read 2026-11-01; 77 +- 4 after 210 C/2 h)

co2_per_kg.source: Ashby 2013 aluminium family 12 (Useful Numbers PDF p. 1, read 2026-11-01); range 4.5-22 = IAI 'most footprints' (sub-agent fetch 2026-11-01); powder atomisation not added (ORNL: +2.4 % energy for Ti powder)

price_per_kg.source: AlSi10Mg powder: Depboylu et al. SFF 2024 p. 1 (135-145 USD/kg standard, ~85 NExP-1); research_notes/Hafifletme derin araştırma 2/cost_data.md (sub-agent 2026-11-01; EUR at ECB 16 Sep 2026)

route_cost_per_kg.source: L-PBF route excluding powder: AMPOWER ~298 EUR/kg Al to Simpson 2021 EOS M290; research_notes/Hafifletme derin araştırma 2/cost_data.md (sub-agent 2026-11-01; EUR at ECB 16 Sep 2026)

Scalmalloy.properties_source: 3D Systems Scalmalloy datasheet, stress-relieved 325 C/4 h: Rp0.2 490-500 MPa; density 2670 kg/m3 from the APWORKS sheet (sub-agent full PDF 2026-11-01); E = 69 GPa horizontal after 325 C/4 h (Colibrium Additive M2 Series 5 Al-Mg-Sc datasheet 2025-08-21 RevB, ASTM E8, read 2026-11-01; 70 GPa as-built); yield 319 MPa at 150 C and 60 MPa at 300 C (same sheet)

co2_per_kg.source: 0.35 kg AlSc2% master alloy per kg (Sc 0.7 wt%, Mehta et al. 2022 Metals 12:57 Table 2, read 2026-11-01) x 172 kg CO2e/kg AlSc2% (Hengevoss et al. 2024 Cleaner Waste Systems 7:100129 Table 1, novel bauxite-residue route, read 2026-11-01) + 0.65 kg Al x 12 = 68 (low); the same paper puts the novel route at about half the state-of-the-art Sc2O3 GWP -> Sc share x2 = 128 (value, current supply)

price_per_kg.source: Scalmalloy powder: no published price found, placeholder; research_notes/Hafifletme derin araştırma 2/cost_data.md (sub-agent 2026-11-01; EUR at ECB 16 Sep 2026)

route_cost_per_kg.source: L-PBF route excluding powder: AMPOWER ~298 EUR/kg Al to Simpson 2021 EOS M290; research_notes/Hafifletme derin araştırma 2/cost_data.md (sub-agent 2026-11-01; EUR at ECB 16 Sep 2026)

buy_to_fly.source: ORNL/TM-2014/93 Tables 6-7: machined brackets 8:1 and 33:1 (sub-agent full text)

mass_factor.source: assumption: topology optimisation with an extrusion / pull-out constraint keeps a machinable shape and saves less than AM

process_MJ_per_kg.source: ORNL/TM-2014/93 appendix: EBM 118.9, Arcam A1 61, DMLS 158.4 MJ/kg

mass_factor.source: flown AM parts 30-50 % lighter (A350 bracket, Liebherr, RUAG, Bionic Partition; decision catalogue D-03)
